title: Queue reservation scan can observe a vanished memory-reservation file
body: During the queued capture-witness retry, /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh line 625 emitted ENOENT for /tmp/undertow-box-memory-reservation.4150545 while scanning reservations; that attempt was canceled before CTest began because another DZN run was active, and the next isolated invocation completed. The same race recurred during the latest-wave all-check-target admission scan for /tmp/undertow-box-memory-reservation.472259; that build request later completed with no work to do. Make reservation scans tolerate files removed concurrently, such as by ignoring ENOENT per entry, so cleanup does not disrupt admission.

title: Queued Ninja frontend rejects the force-rebuild flag
body: Exact failed invocation: bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent bswave --resource build --label latest-wave-force-all-checks -- cmake --build build/wsl --target octreeconfig_check recipeparams_check recipe_simd_check sdf_core_kernels_check recipe_opcode_mirror_check lightingconfig_check shadowconfig_check accumulationconfig_check prevcameraconfig_check reservoirconfig_check probegridconfig_check lighttreebuffer_check miningbeambuffer_check reservoirrecord_check view_hud_check view_editor_layers_check view_hud_markup_check view_hud_blob_check view_hud_writer_check appflow_check view_noun_enum_check callables_check no_new_mutex_check --parallel 4 -- -B. It exited 1 before running checks because /home/liory/.local/bin/ninja rejected -B. Recovery: bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent bswave --resource build --label latest-wave-release-clean-build-checks -- cmake --build build/wsl --clean-first --parallel 8 completed successfully, rebuilding 1,147 actions and passing all 22 codegen check targets. Document the queue Ninja frontend force-rebuild interface or support the expected option.

title: Queued no-op CMake builds inherit the cold-build reservation estimate
body: Exact initial invocation: bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent bswave --resource build --label latest-wave-final-noop-rebuild -- cmake --build build/wsl --parallel 8. The request remained queued for about four minutes at need=3/projected=6945MB even though the clean build and tests had completed and the build graph was current; reissuing with --parallel 1 still received the same estimate. Recovery used the queue-supported --credits 1 override plus --parallel 1 and completed with ninja reporting no work to do. Estimate up-to-date/incremental builds from their actual work or provide a documented no-op reservation profile so a completed tree does not wait behind cold-build reservations.
